lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to give clones different speeds, sizes and reactions, and detect when a clone touches the player.
Use pick random inside the clone’s script so every clone gets its own size, position or costume.
Each clone can check if it is touching the player.
When it is, it can change the score and delete itself.
For games, use a forever loop that checks keys.
The player moves smoothly while you hold the key.
Use a variable for the fall speed and change it as the game goes on.
Every new clone falls a little faster.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
